title: Add an email field and serialize it
prompt: Add an `email` field across two files. In model.py, User.__init__ must accept and store email. In serialize.py, serialize_user() must include email. serialize_user(User("Ada", "ada@x.com")) must return {"name": "Ada", "email": "ada@x.com"}. Both files must change.
optimal_steps_note: Minimum tool calls with run_verify available: one write per allowed file, one verify, one finish. Files are seeded into the prompt, so reads are not required. The verify-off arm has a floor one lower.
